notes.title: Devlog From Behind The Bars #19 Concrete Nightmares: Mapping the Prison
notes.content:
Hello Prisoners!

Welcome back to another devlog for Prison Survival!

This week, we’re zooming out - way out - to talk not about cells or guards, but about the prison itself. 
The walls, the corridors, the hidden corners where trouble brews… that’s the stage where all your survival stories unfold.

🏛️ Inspired by the "Real Thing"

We didn’t just throw some walls together and call it a prison. Nope - we studied real layouts of correctional facilities. From cell blocks to cafeteria lines, our design is rooted in reality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/38e24ef37dac8b75d93a6becaff8fd0ccd240472.jpg

it’s about how the space shapes your choices. A long corridor means you’re exposed. A blind corner means opportunity. And that giant yard? It’s either your playground… or your battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/ecc794303afc18c8842a2debefedba716f6b88c2.gif

🏗️ Concrete Nightmares

We’re excited to show you some early engine shots of the prison layout.
Think of it as a blueprint come to life – blocky, raw, but full of potential. You’ll see how the different zones (cells, cafeteria, yard, workshops) connect, and maybe even start imagining your escape routes already ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/ec16038aadc4db9121ce4b51572ceaf6f56b958f.gif

🖼️ A Peek Behind the Bars
Of course here you can see very early stage of development but in next devlogs im gonna show you some more detailed views. Prison in full version will be really different from a facility you saw in our playtests.
Until then, study the maps layout carefully… survival favors the prepared.

Take care, inmates!
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Devlog From Behind The Bars #18 Guards - friend or foe?
notes.content:
Hello Prisoners!

Stand up! Be quiet! Your fav CO is speaking! ;)

Welcome back to another devlog for Prison Survival! 
This time we’re shining the spotlight on the people who make sure your prison “staycation” doesn’t get too comfy… the guards.

Guards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/bf2f17c220d89bd4d76d497e642dd408db6d21d5.png

They patrol the halls, they break up fights, they yell at you for no reason (or at least it feels that way). 
But in Prison Survival, guards aren’t just background - they’re a whole faction in the prison ecosystem.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/066afaa730fb454fea516c0d502aa98cb87433c8.png

We’ve added different types of guards, each with their own quirks, routines. Some are strict, some are lazy, and some might even look the other way if you’ve got the right connections.

Friend or Foe?

Here’s the twist: guards aren’t just enemies. They can be allies too. Sure, they’re the 4th “gang” in our little prison world, and yeah, they’ll happily bust you if you’re up to trouble…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/401407768553b2b3b7f9482c4afffc262a441e2e.gif

…but bribe the right one, run errands, or simply earn their trust, and suddenly you’ve got protection, privileges, and maybe even a guard who “forgets” to lock a door.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/ecdc6b6cbe50089480f28547096265183274c4a0.jpg
It is not easy to be a prison guard. But you wanna try? Play Prison Simulator - i heard it's a good game ;)

Take care, inmates!
Baked Games Team

Stand up! Be quiet! Your fav CO is speaking! ;)

Gangs

Here’s the deal with the gans in prison: you’ll need to work with other gangs… and sometimes fight them.
Maybe you’ll trade protection for favors, maybe you’ll get double-crossed in the cafeteria - but hey, that’s prison life. 

The balance of power shifts every day, so you’ll need strategy, charm, and a little chaos to make it out on top!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/51ae6969886a212ddbd349fbaebeb4e2a62326e2.png

Do you want your own gang? You got it! Wanna take over another gang? 
That’s on the table too-though we’re still figuring out if it’ll be a feature.

Hidden BOSS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/fb858d3e4a2ab58dcd1483553aa7c0e6f6d2c4ea.png

And speaking of bosses… meet one of our standout characters:
Don’t let the silver hair and slick glasses fool you. This guy is the definition of a gangster. He can plan a twisted plan while sipping coffee and making the entire prison think he’s harmless. 

More screens of how we made him:

notes.title: Devlog From Behind The Bars #15 - Contraband and trade
notes.content:
Hello Prisoners!

Stand up! Be quiet! Your fav CO is speaking! ;)

Welcome back to another devlog for Prison Survival! 

First of all – HUGE thanks to everyone who's currently participating in the playtests! You're helping us a ton, and your feedback is pure gold!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/8b622f777b5bd2a42602730d59e62af023d28994.gif

Prison trading

So yes – in our game, survival isn’t just about keeping your head down and avoiding bad looks. It’s also about making connections. Trading snacks for favors. Swapping meds for smokes. Smuggling in that “very illegal but very needed” item past the guards without getting your face reintroduced to the floor.

Trade in real prisons is a whole ecosystem, and we’re building our little prison system too! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/fa7bc6022076343a1f401ba6819c501c494208f9.gif

BUT! In the current playtest, this system is only lightly represented. Think of it as a little teaser - just a taste. 
The real dirty deals are coming in the demo and the full release, where we’ll be introducing deeper trade mechanics, more contraband "items", and more “creative” ways to sneak them past the guards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/9a906189c2872261a447e1c774bef6659b80a7f6.png
Remember "Freeman" from the last devlog? He is one of the traders!

Let’s be honest, what’s prison life without a little chaos and a guy trying to sell you painkillers wrapped in toilet paper?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/06c5d10746ed778c007648a5e61a6ec9d9aefec9.png
Catching with "stuff" can occur in worse punishment than ever!

Thanks again for playing, testing. More devlogs soon!

Take care, inmates!

notes.title: Prison Survival Playtests Has Begun!
notes.content:
Hello Prisoners!


We're excited to announce that playtests for Prison Survival are now live!


You can join starting today, July 24 at 3:00 PM CEST, until August 7.

To join the playtest, simply visit our Prison Survival's Steam page and click “Request Access” - access will be granted automatically.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983910/"][/dynamiclink]


 🔥What is in this playtest? 

Prison Survival is a first-person prison stealth-action game set in a semi-open prison environment. 
You’re free to explore – but some areas are off-limits. 
Enter a Restricted Area, and guards or security cameras will be on your tail. 
If they catch you – you're sent back to a checkpoint.

You can run, hide, or use parkour to escape – climb pipes, ledges, or sneak through ventilation shafts. You can also fight other inmates with your fists!

The art style is slightly stylized, but we’re keeping the gritty prison atmosphere: gangs, drugs, fights, foul language, and the daily grind of prison life!


[previewyoutube="wKjJcNnzYjo;full"][/previewyoutube]



🔥 What is your goal in Prison Survial Playtest?

You work for a prison boss. Your job? Smuggle contraband – drugs, weapons, and other illegal items.
Pick up orders, avoid or take down guards, use parkour, disable cameras, fight rival inmates, deliver the goods and get back to your cell and go to sleep ;)

You can also buy helpful tools (like lockpicks, remote camera disablers, or a map), or train parkour in a dedicated area!


📢 Join Our Community!

Visit our Discord for FAQ, control explanations, and to grab the press kit !


📋Deliver your message!

Press F5 during a game to report a bug or a suggestion!
We need your feedback! Help us and become a part of Prison Survival!

CLICK HERE TO FILL A QUESTIONNAIRE !

 👀Invite your friends!
Once you gain access to the playtest, you’ll be able to use Steam’s new feature to bring your friends… straight to prison 😉 Don't hesitate to invite your firends to Prison Survival Playtest!

------------------
Take care, inmates!
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Devlog From Behind The Bars #14 "Free-man" in prison?!

Hello Prisoners!

Stand up! Be quiet! Your fav CO is speaking! ;)

Welcome back to another devlog for Prison Survival! 

We’ve been cooking up some new inmates for Prison Survival, and today we want to share a behind-the-scenes look at one of our most unexpected creations...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/94b2e234f1b04e0290cc854e3f56236ea3b5884f.jpg

The Birth of  Morgan Jailman

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/930b089725c20edb823b5473ff01c1ab5fdde233.jpg

So, one of our talented artists was sculpting a new inmate in Blender. Things were going fine - until we zoomed out and realized... HE LOOKS LIKE SOMEONE.

The resemblance was uncanny -  calm expression, wise eyes, and that unmistakable character.
Naturally, we did the only logical thing: We named him “Jailman.”

Sculpting

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/d75c33d5b5abcdf72dc44e34933159c7425d3bdd.gif

In the process, we experimented with different hair options - fully bald? Short curls? Gray sideburns?

We even made a before and after comparison image we call.


3D Details

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/29b562c79b1209a830a456dbf73b0e541d5b09c3.gif

On the technical side:

-Facial rigging for realistic expressions

-Blendshapes for aging effects (wrinkles, subtle eye bags)

-Modular hair support for future inmates 

We’re building systems so characters can look unique - and occasionally, unintentionally famous!


Take care, inmates!

notes.title: Devlog From Behind The Bars #11 Showers - a water level in prison?
notes.content:
Hello Prisoners!

Stand up! Be quiet! Your fav CO is speaking! ;)

Welcome back to another devlog for Prison Survival! 

Today, we’re diving deep (not literally, we hope) into one of the most essential but often overlooked aspects of prison life: HYGIENE! 

Plus, let’s talk about sinks, toilets, and how water (or the lack of it) can shape the prison experience.


"Those damned Water Levels!"

Prisoners need showers, but not all of them enjoy it. Some see it as a social event, others as a necessary evil. You can use shower to hide from guards, prefom some off-scene activities or relieve yourself (and your psyche)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/13472b1fc349377170225532610275cbe1c819ca.gif

Skibidi Toilet 

Ever seen a grown man fight over a toilet? In our game, you will.
Not only are toilets essential for hygiene and morale, but their placement can become a tactical power move. 
Who gets stuck with the one that barely even flushes? 
Important but often overlooked thing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/7023af09df6341ee7b68d407b2103973ca78c0c8.gif

Psychology of Cleanliness
It’s not just about looking (and smelling) good. Hygiene has a direct impact on a prisoner’s mental state. A clean, well-maintained prison can reduce tensions, while filth and neglect lead to unrest. 
in every cell there are sinks that ALWAYS works. 
If you for some reason can't go to showers: use this to clean your prisoner a little. Reduce your stress.
Hey, its always something!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/faf5ed74c2c9c3fe030ba9a8f5c78c3f6673f678.gif



Take care, inmates!
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Devlog From Behind The Bars #6 - Dealing "stuff" - the REAL prison job
notes.content:
Hello Prisoners!

Stand up! Be quiet! Your fav CO is speaking! ;)

Hey there, future prison kingpins! 
Time to talk about one of the most "productive" ways to spend your time behind bars: dealing stuff.

Clients: Friend or foe?

Your clients? Fellow inmates with a range of personalities and needs. Some are desperate for a fix, others are opportunists looking to flip your goods for a profit. Each interaction will test your negotiation skills, timing, and awareness of who’s watching.

In this devlogs i will show you how me made it from scratch - a dealing stuff system. Yeah, thats how i call it. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/baa0de5093bffc17710eb07b6176feb6a0052038.gif


Don't get caught doing business!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/74e6123e7b67a2e9f84f86c4e551f5eb29367b66.gif

Basics:
-get a client
-get a clue about the stuff
-get the stuff (don't be catched in the meantime)
-go back to client 
-get your money or items (prepare for negotiate)
-REPEAT

Simple? And a new movement mechanisc will help you with that! Also some missions will need you to fight or get stealthy. But the main premise will remain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/0cf9e2828155aaa0176c55ea75aad87087b0bd0f.gif
 Get ready to become the prison’s top dealer—or if you just want to survive without getting busted. 
Guards, cameras and even other inmates can interrupt your business!

Blue Stuff vs. Red Stuff

Here’s the deal (literally):
-Blue Stuff: High-quality, high-demand, and gets you big bucks. But it’s more risky.
-Red Stuff: Cheaper, easier to move, but not as much profit.

Movement is CRUCIAL. Also specific clients need specific stuff. But sometimes can take the other one. Pick your poison wisely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/93c9cca5c777ec589d0da022773ec9be81fbfd66.gif

Until next time, stay sneaky! ;)


Take care, inmates!

Hello Prisoners!

Welcome to another devlog for Prison Survival Architect of Crime Simulator. 
Today, we’re diving into the world of tatoos ;)

Tattoos: Your Mark of Identity

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/ab9028cd47786d14ec23ae48840c5ec2d34be2cf.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/f922867600637871f3217b24fd924910a366ae35.gif

In Prison Survival Architect of Crime Simulator, tattoos are more than just a visual element – they reflect your prisoner’s status, gang affiliation, and accomplishments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/a6073b63a45bade0ee53514169c0aef43ff42690.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/1443d7504825ddc889bf4389b5eface1653a170b.gif

Crafting the tattoos for the game was a challenging yet rewarding process. We took inspiration from real-world prison tattoos as well as contemporary street art. 


We paid special attention to details like shading, skin texture, and even imperfections like ink smudges to make the tattoos feel gritty and authentic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/321db58ff83091c9caf509dd40abafd9511c6ab0.gif

Many of these tattoos are linked to specific gangs, meaning wearing one can impact how other prisoners interact with you, affecting everything from alliances to confrontations. You can earn tattoos designs through various missions and quests. 

Tattoo Editing System – Your Body, Your Rules

Tattoos in our game go far beyond pre-made templates. We’ve created an advanced tool that allows players to fully customize tattoos, including the ability to design and upload their own images!

Designing the Prisoners

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/fcff444db77cccb2dedca7216ceda840ccbef139.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/6518362d37fbb039a9414fa699b37c8efa3b23cb.gif

Creating the prisoners in Prison Survival Architect of Crime Simulator was one of the biggest challenges we faced. We wanted to design characters that felt dynamic, gritty, and reflective of the harsh realities of life inside a maximum-security prison

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/98adec451f10a826d79ddb0887ed9db71e3eb1ad.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/f8629146fdaf7d289cf9d5f413a00930c6b59307.gif

The process of building these prisoners involved a lot of detailed work, not just in terms of their visual appearance, but also in how their bodies, personalities, and behaviors evolve over time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/cae73f13c79459cebca9ee6010fb9a10819ef31a.gif

We concentrated on the realistic FACES. Why? In first person perspective games you will see the faces of the characters very often and very CLOSE BY.
The face of your prisoner isn't static; we built a system where facial expressions react to in-game events, like getting into fights, dealing with stress, or even forming alliances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/f15f3d721870b50111263d31f485fa76fb5419bf.png
Face almost ready. Doesnt it look like a high quality mask you can buy?

We wanted the prisoners to have faces that tell their story – from hardened criminals with scars and angry expressions, to more calculating inmates with cold, piercing eyes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/3deaee8b554557d2a6e0162f9b385d77ca64c319.gif
Not a good day to be a prisoner
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/601d9396d04ffaa3b1d3ffed0dc3f62d1c015886.gif

Each gang has a distinct tattoo style, which you can further customize to immerse yourself in the role of your prisoner.

notes.title: Devlog From Behind The Bars #1 - Welcome to the new prison!
notes.content:
Hello Prisoners!

Stand up! Be quiet! And get ready for a new devlog series!

I'm going to take you on a journey through the construction of our brand-new prison-related game! Ever wanted to take on the role of a prisoner in Prison Simulator? Well, now you can! You will be an inmate in Prison Survival: Architect of Crime Simulator!

This devlog will delve into the creation process of our new PRISON, or at least a part of this entire prison complex.

Cell Block Secrets
How do we create a place so challenging, so immersive, that every moment feels like a fight for survival? We drew inspiration from real-world prisons and blended it with our own twisted imagination to create something truly unique.

We started our new prison with the CELLS.
What does every cell need?
A. Bed
B. Sink
C. Place for a hidden stash
D. Prisoner
E. All of the above ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/452003693a136352836eb6c04eb24cffcde0b6ed.gif

Welcome to your new home, dude!

Will this blanket keep you warm at night?
If not, just ask a friendly cellmate ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/4c9d200b45ba5a0f280c04ded3da678860293ab7.gif

Bunk beds

They don't look the same - yeah, it's a copy but only the BASE bed is the same. Later, we will add more variety to almost every bed. Each one will be unique - just like the prisoners sleeping on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44380057/73b02a59073974a6449f7be62e6215e535c6fa29.gif

Prison bars are essential. We created immersive-looking bars, but don't worry, we haven't forgotten about doors ;)

notes.title: "Tribe: Primitive Builder" Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello, Players!

Together with Polyslash we're excited to share some thrilling news today. "Tribe: Primitive Builder," our prehistoric city-building and survival game, is now officially available on Steam. 

It's been an exhilarating journey, and we can't wait to take you back in time to the age of primitive tribes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/27dc73bdd279116e1e3116f6beeb3cacabf8d1b6.jpg

The Launch Day - Unleash Your Inner Primitive Builder!

After months of hard work, sleepless nights, and countless playtesting sessions, "Tribe: Primitive Builder" is ready to make its mark on Steam. The game is now live and available for purchase. Get ready to lead your tribe to prosperity in a stunning prehistoric world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/bf46bc5227b765e378b28d0748ad802dc682175d.jpg

Community Hub: Join the Tribe!

A great game deserves an equally great community, and we invite you to join ours on the Steam Community Hub for "Tribe: Primitive Builder." 
Share your strategies, discuss the best ways to survive, and connect with fellow prehistoric architects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/2b65e089c9f50fab89b601ea8da3792be51ea69a.jpg


Tribe+Prison bundle!

"Tribe: Primitive Builder" is now available on Steam, and we can't wait for you to embark on your adventure. Get your copy today and let's build, survive, and thrive together!
Also a Prison Simulator+Tribe:Primitive Builder bundle will be available!
Get this to achieve a -10% discount!

Click HERE to get a bundle! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/69ec499bee4a7ac866ee1d45812e0da6625b0215.jpg

A Big Thank You

It's a joint cooperation of many developers, here in Baked Games and other companies :D 
We're immensely proud of what we've achieved together.

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Steam Next Festival - New Demos for Neuroshima Hex and Hammer of Pain!
notes.content:
Special announcement!

Hello travelers!

We hope you're all set to dive into the gaming extravaganza that is Steam Next Festival!
We've got some thrilling news to share with you that will add more fun to your festival experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/88d36564c93b6d71378355fc0e91e9ae0e9c210a.png

Introducing brand-new demos for two of our epic titles, Neuroshima Hex and Hammer of Pain!

We're cranking up the fun factor to the limit, and we can't wait for you to jump in and play. 
These demos will be available at the start of Steam Next Festival on 9th October 2023!

Neuroshima Hex Demo:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/9659a0cce87aa1972a02116cdd242477c1999fec.gif

Calling all strategic masterminds! Get ready to flex your tactical muscles with our revamped Neuroshima Hex demo. 
It's the perfect way to dip your toes into the world of Mad Max-inspired battles, where every move counts. 
The demo even supports online multiplayer, so you can test your skills against players from around the world!

Click here to play the Neuroshima Hex demo right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2324150?utm_source=CCdv       

Hammer of Pain Demo:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/bc2e46b72456d562a897c529c3df0739a734e224.gif

For those who crave adrenaline-pumping, heart-thumping action, our Hammer of Pain demo is your ticket to an epic journey of chaos and conquest. Dive headfirst into this brutal world and show 'em who's boss. Plus, enjoy the beautiful retro-inspired pixel art graphics!

Click here to play the Hammer of Pain demo right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438440/Hammer_of_Pain/?utm_source=CCdv 

Community and Contest:

We want to hear feedback from you! Share your demo experiences, epic victories, and hilarious defeats with the gaming community on Steam or our Discord server. 

Speaking of Discord, during the festival, we'll be hosting a special CONTEST on our official server!

What are the rules? You play our demos and aim to be the very best! You can then win great prizes! More info on the Discord server.

Join our Discord server here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/dcfd6c6d8c00027ba503f254277de421f6aec639.png

Best regards,
Baked Games Team
